visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Real people appear in the frame. A man wearing a black baseball cap and a black t-shirt with a red logo sits beside a young girl in a white t-shirt at a light-colored dining table. The background shows a modern living room with gray walls, a split-unit air conditioner, and light-colored curtains. A red Mister Donut box and several individually wrapped pastries are positioned in front of them. (2) The camera cuts to a top-down close-up of a chocolate donut, identified by on-screen text. It is heavily coated in dark chocolate frosting, sprinkled with chocolate shavings and a light dusting of cocoa powder, sitting in a branded HERSHEY'S cardboard tray. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the girl picks up the chocolate donut and takes a large bite while the man watches and then takes his own bite. The girl reaches for a yellow plastic cup with a straw and takes a drink, her expression thoughtful as they discuss the texture. (4) A close-up reveals a heart-shaped pastry, the Pistachio Cocoa Shell, which is covered in dark cocoa powder and topped with a small, pale green pistachio cream dollop. The background is a clean white surface, highlighting the dark brown color of the pastry. (5) The man and the girl are shown eating the heart-shaped pastry in a medium shot. The man holds his half towards the camera to show the pale green pistachio filling inside. They use their hands to tear pieces off, and the girl looks directly at the camera while chewing. (6) A close-up shows the Cocoa Shell pastry, which is similar in shape to the previous one but features a darker brown chocolate cream dollop on top instead of pistachio. The pastry is resting in its branded brown and white HERSHEY'S packaging. (7) Back in the medium shot, the man and girl are tasting the Cocoa Shell. The man is talking animatedly, using hand gestures to describe the flavor, while the girl nods in agreement, still holding her piece of the pastry. (8) A close-up features the Almond Chocolate Pon de Ring, a ring-shaped donut consisting of connected dough balls, glazed in dark chocolate and topped with crushed almonds and a chocolate drizzle. It is partially visible inside its clear plastic and branded paper sleeve. (9) The man holds the Almond Chocolate Pon de Ring up to the camera before they both take bites. The girl smiles while she eats, and the man points towards the donut while speaking, his facial expressions showing excitement about the flavor. (10) A close-up shows the Raw Cocoa Pon de Ring, a dark chocolate ring donut inside its packaging. The man's hand is visible holding the clear plastic bag, which has the HERSHEY'S logo and since 1894 printed on it. (11) In the final medium shot, the man and girl finish their tasting. The man gives a thumbs-up gesture and holds up the Raw Cocoa Pon de Ring packaging. They both look happy and satisfied, continuing their conversation until the video concludes.
